title: Binocular-view rendering: bright ringed orb over ridgeline, night sky
description: Digital recreation (rendering 2 of 2) of the 2026 sighting simulating a binocular field of view. A brilliant white orb surrounded by concentric halo rings sits over a dark ridgeline in a star-filled sky with the Milky Way at right; small teal data annotations and an orange timestamp overlay mimic device UI.
